See the worked example at the bottom (level 5 Warrior vs Meadow Boar). Monster stats live on the monsters tab. Healing drinks are Meadow Dew / Clear Dew / Spring Draught / Mint Draught.

main_stat is STR (Warrior), INT (Mage), or AGI (Rogue). Wooden/worn/rusty weapons: weapon_damage 10, multiplier 1.1. Steel: 18 and 1.25. Unarmed: weapon_damage 6, multiplier 1.0. Armor defense does not add to attack. Armor stat_multiplier is unused in v0.
skill_multiplier is the skill's damage_multiplier (1.4 = 140%). Auto/basic swing with no skill uses multiplier 1.0. Min damage = max(1, floor(0.05 × skill_multiplier × attack)).
Stops high defense from fully soaking a hit.
Before AGI. Rolled per hit except where a skill says otherwise.
Crit chance = 5% + AGI × 0.4%.
A crit deals 150% of the already-computed hit. Backstab is a guaranteed crit whose 250% already includes this — do not apply 1.5× again.
Base 1.0s between basic skill uses (short cooldown). AGI shortens it. Placeholder.
v0: attacks otherwise always hit. No separate monster accuracy table in Meadows. Can add accuracy later.
player_defense is the sum of worn armor defense (cloth set = 12, leather set = 19). Same min_damage rule, using monster_attack as the pre-defense amount.

rows.value: 3-5 basic skill hits at level parity
rows.notes: Tuned around a typical player: ~80% of points in the class main stat, remainder in SPI, Wooden/Worn/Rusty weapon. Cloth armor is common from the shop by mid Meadows (defense 12).

Old Stump 4200 HP / Night Stump 4500 HP. A level 10 Warrior's Power Strike deals ~119 after defense; ~35 hits. At a 1s cooldown with dodging and movement this is about 1-1.5 minutes. Category skills (Flame Cleave 200%, etc.) pull it toward 1 minute. Placeholder.

rows.value: 5-10% of player HP per hit at level parity
rows.notes: After subtracting typical player defense. A same-level melee trade should not burst the player, but two or three ignored hits should be felt.
Worked example. Boar is level 7, so this is a slightly hard fight (two levels above), not exact parity.

rows.value: STR 20, SPI 5 (all 25 points). Wooden Sword. Full cloth (defense 12).
rows.notes: A reasonable mid-Meadows Warrior who bought starter cloth from the town vendor.
40 + 4×4 = 56. Regen = 0.5 + 5×0.15 = 1.25 MP/s. Power Strike costs 8 MP.
floor(1.4 × 55 − 12) = floor(77 − 12) = 65. No crit.

Boar HP 450 / 65 ≈ 6.9, so 7 hits. At a 1s cooldown this is about 7s if the player never misses or runs. Longer than the 3-5 hit parity target because the Boar is two levels higher; a level 7 Warrior (STR 28) deals 90 after defense and kills in 5 hits.
floor(36 − 12) = 24. Inside the 5-10% band. If they trade 6 hits the Warrior takes 144 and wins with about 45% HP left (or drinks a Meadow Dew for 40).
About 9 Boars to level if the Warrior stayed here, or a mix with other mid monsters.
